Welcome back to the channel. Today we are talking about how to build a morning routine that actually sticks. Most people try to change everything at once, and that is exactly why they fail. Instead, start with one small habit. For example, drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up. It takes ten seconds, and it signals to your brain that the day has started. Once that feels automatic, add a second habit, like a five-minute walk outside. The key is consistency, not intensity. Track your streak on a calendar and celebrate small wins. In 30 days, you will be surprised at how much has changed.
